First native pre-release of ParanO(1)d.

This release packages the self-contained node, CLI and external miner for Linux x86-64, Linux ARM64, Windows x86-64, macOS Apple Silicon and macOS Intel.

The node embeds the build-authenticated B64/m23 and B255/m24 HistoryStep matrices. The canonical matrix pack and SHA-256 manifests are attached for independent reproduction.

Pre-genesis software. No public network is active at this version.
